title: Python Asyncio Concurrency Plan
description: A structured asyncio concurrency design (interpreter version, fan-out primitive, blocking-call offload, timeout/cancellation posture), so this skill's trap catalog and Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/python_asyncio_pitfalls_audit.mjs.

pythonMinor.description: The Python 3.x minor version the code targets (e.g. 11 for Python 3.11). Gates TaskGroup and asyncio.timeout availability.

fanOutPrimitive.description: The primitive used for concurrent fan-out. taskgroup is the safe default on 3.11+.

siblingCancellationRequired.description: True if a failure in one fan-out task should cancel its siblings.

blockingCallsPresent.description: True if any synchronous/blocking call (requests, time.sleep, psycopg2, CPU-bound work) sits inside a coroutine path.

blockingOffload.description: How blocking calls are kept off the loop. Required to be non-none when blockingCallsPresent is true.

externalCallsHaveTimeouts.description: True if every awaited external call (HTTP, DB, queue peer) is wrapped in a timeout.

timeoutPrimitive.description: Which timeout primitive is used. asyncio.timeout requires 3.11+ and integrates with TaskGroup.

cancelledErrorReRaised.description: True if every except CancelledError handler re-raises after cleanup.

usesQueue.description: True if the design uses an asyncio.Queue between producers and consumers.

queueBounded.description: True if every asyncio.Queue has an explicit maxsize for backpressure.

usesSyncQueue.description: True if queue.Queue (the synchronous one) appears inside async code. Must be false.

connectionPoolsAtStartup.description: True if connection pools (httpx.AsyncClient, asyncpg) are constructed once at app startup, not per request.

requestScopedState.description: How request-scoped state is carried. contextvars is the only task-safe answer.

debugModeInDev.description: True if loop.set_debug(True) / PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG=1 is enabled in dev, with slow_callback_duration alerting in prod.
